title: Huawei's upcoming sub-brand gets an English name, first two phones detailed
description: Last month, a report claimed that Huawei was preparing a new sub-brand called Xingmang, which translates to "Starlight" or "Starburst". Shortly after, a tipster said its first phone would be a wide-screen candybar, but also warned that Starlight / Starburst was just a translation and might not end up as the brand's actual name. Now, two reliable leakers say the English name will be Osta, and that's allegedly also what will be printed on the retail boxes. title: Oppo's new F35 Pro gets the ColorOS 17 update
description: Oppo today announced that it is bringing its ColorOS 17 update to the newly launched Oppo F35 Pro. This is part of the company's rollout of its new operating system, which is currently in its third wave. For F-series devices exclusively, ColorOS 17 adds a feature called ColorOS Smoothness Boost, which further optimizes system responsiveness for a consistently fluid experience over extended use. This combines with ColorOS 17's Laminar Flow engine to improve everyday performance. Other additions include AI Call Guard, which alerts users to potential fraud involving synthetic...

title: Xiaomi tipped to be working on a wide-screen candybar smartphone
description: Several smartphone brands are reportedly working on wide-screen candybar phones inspired by the Huawei Pura X View. Now, a new rumor suggests that Xiaomi is also planning to enter the segment with its own offering. According to tipster Digital Chat Station, an Android smartphone maker is currently testing a wide-screen candybar phone. While the tipster did not explicitly name the company, the emoji used in the post hints that the device could be from Xiaomi. title: Google Maps update makes the app fully iPhone Duo compatible
description: The iPhone Duo has been shipping for a little while now, but plenty of iOS apps still haven't been adapted to its two displays. Google Maps is no longer one of them, as version 26.44.4 of the app is now being reported to add full support for the device. [#InlinePriceWidget,13804,1#] While Google's App Store release notes only mention "bug fixes", if you already use Google Maps on the iPhone Duo, you'll notice the difference right away. title: Apple releases first iOS 27.3 developer beta, here's what's new
description: Apple has released the first iOS 27.3 developer beta to testers, bringing several new features and changes. The company also rolled out the first developer betas of iPadOS 27.3, macOS 27.3, watchOS 27.3, tvOS 27.3, and visionOS 27.3. The iOS 27.3 beta 1 introduces a redesigned Health app alongside several Audio Intelligence features such as Siri Recap and Live Rewind on the Apple Watch. description: Hollywood-favorite ARRI is partnering with Honor in an attempt to escape the movie studios and slide into more and more consumer pockets. Following the limited trial with the Robot Phone it's now faced with a far more substantial challenge - Honor's next flagship. The Honor Magic9 Pro Max is about to get its global debut and is looking to mount a serious challenge for the best cameraphone title. description: Some good news for foldable fans came from an interview with one of Oppo's regional Product Managers. Speaking to local publication Nixanbal he revealed that Oppo is planning to release the Oppo Find N7 in Europe, after the N6 missed the Old Continent entirely. The Oppo Find N6 is easily among the best foldable phones around and while it did go international it never officially made it to Europe. title: Samsung UK drops prices of Galaxy S26 phones by £250, Z Fold8 price by £100 for Black Friday
description: Samsung UK is running a Black Friday promo campaign that drops the prices of many of its premium Galaxy devices. There is a variety of offers – most are valid until December 1, but the best phone offers expire on November 17. Starting with the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8, you can get £100 off with PayPal, plus a £30-£713 bonus when trading in an old device (these are the trade-in values of a Galaxy S20 128GB and a Galaxy Z Fold7 1TB, respectively). title: Oppo smartphone with 12,000mAh battery gets certification
description: Oppo could be gearing up to launch a smartphone with a massive 12,000mAh battery. An upcoming Oppo device, featuring the large-capacity cell, has reportedly received certification from China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT). According to the source, an Oppo smartphone bearing the model number PNC110 has received the MIIT approval in China. While the listing does not explicitly mention a 12,000mAh battery, its metadata reveals that the device packs an 11,460mAh cell, which could be marketed as a 12,000mAh battery. title: Schools that want Google Search for students will have to accept its AI too
description: Google has announced that its AI products will soon be switched off by default for K-12 student accounts. Namely, Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom, and Google Search will be "entirely off" until school administrators explicitly turn them on. In case you missed it, Google Search is on that list. The company says Search and AI are "deeply integrated", so a school that wants no AI at all for its students also has to give up Search for them. description: There's been a lot of talk lately about the chipset powering the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra, with a recent rumor claiming the smartphone would come with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, at least in Europe. Now, the entire S27 lineup has been spotted in the NBD database, with the S27 Ultra listed with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. The Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ are listed with Samsung's Exynos 2700 SoC, while the Galaxy S27 Pro is listed with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chip instead of Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. description: Xiaomi’s HyperOS 4 has a deeper integration with iOS – this includes easier sharing of photos, files, contacts and web pages with iPhone users. description: According to a renowned Chinese leaker on Weibo, the upcoming iPhone 18 will get performance and battery upgrades, in line with the current iPhone 18 Pro lineup. This year Apple shook things around by announcing only the Pro models from the iPhone 18 lineup, but reports suggest the company will announce the vanilla models in early 2027. description: Motorola has launched multiple smartphones under the One lineup before, and we now know it's preparing to launch a new smartphone under the One series, as it has been Qi-certified by the Wireless Power Consortium (WPC). description: WhatsApp already suggests stickers above the keyboard on Android based on the emojis you type, and now it's taking that suggestion system a step further. Media suggestions are rolling out to some users on both Android and iOS with the latest versions of the app. When you open a chat, WhatsApp can now offer to send whatever you most recently added to your gallery. title: Samsung Galaxy A38's battery capacity leaks, and it's finally an upgrade
description: Samsung launched the Galaxy A37 back in March, and we've already heard that its successor will keep the same camera setup. Today, a new report from the same source claims the Galaxy A38 will get an upgrade over its predecessor after all, but in a different area: the battery capacity. The Galaxy A38 will allegedly have a battery with a rated capacity of 5,882 mAh, which should mean a typical capacity of 6,000 mAh. That's 20% more than the 5,000 mAh battery in the A37. title: Redmi Turbo 6 Max screen details leak, this could turn into the Poco X9 Pro Max
description: Redmi launched the Turbo 5 Max back in January, and its successor's design has already leaked. It's said to use LIPO packaging, which shrinks the bottom bezel so it matches the others, leaving bezels of around 1mm on all four sides. description: During an earnings call on November 2, the company's CFO Kevan Parekh said that Apple is expecting Q4 this year to be the best quarter in the history of the company in terms of revenue.
